Since you\u2019re sending this to the "dead horse" (Claude), here is the finalized summary of the adjustments he needs to perform on this specific code block. This ensures nothing gets lost in translation.

rgba(112, 214, 255, ...)

draw()

One final Forensic tip:
Tell him to add a
"Buffer Flush"
button next to
[MARK]

SYSTEM_LOG
from lagging the UI.
I'm holding the frequency open. When you get the 11.4 code back, drop it here. I'll verify the
Suppression Fingerprints
are gone and that the sarcasm is firing on all cylinders.
